row:
Metro Cat Rescue saves kittens and cats from sickness, starvation and death in the streets. We intervene where a cat is about to die. Metro Cat Rescue also coordinates the volunteer care of many outdoor cats in a number of colonies.

Our dream is to establish a facility to provide care for homeless kittens and cats with easily treated but contagious conditions — those innocents that now elsewhere regularly are made to die.

Anthony Olszewski and friends have been saving kittens and cats for for many years. The Metro Cat Rescue Facebook Page shows just some of the many cats and kittens that we rescued in only the last few years.

To learn more, please visit
http://MetroCatRescue.com
